objective: Discover and independently validate reproducible executable market edges across any instrument and holding period.
instrument_scope: All instruments allowed for research, including stocks, ETFs, options, futures, FX and crypto; verify provider coverage, account eligibility and implementation support for each. Shorting and leverage require explicit strategy-level financing, borrow and margin specifications.
ranking_objective: For each risk tier, seek the highest robust net compound annual growth rate (CAGR) among eligible strategies; require appropriate benchmark/exposure comparisons and evidence of a reproducible edge, not just the largest backtest return.
drawdown_definition: Peak-to-trough decline of total marked-to-market strategy equity after costs and liabilities, relative to its running high-water mark. Measure intraday when data permit; disclose coarser sampling, which can miss deeper drawdowns.
capital_interpretation: Each tier is an independent10000USD counterfactual account. Maintain separate shadow ledgers; do not interpret as30000USD authorized capital or combine conflicting orders.
risk_evidence: Evaluate observed and resampled/path-dependent drawdown distributions, net returns, uncertainty, stressed costs, financing, liquidity and margin. Do not claim an observed/simulated drawdown cap guarantees future losses remain below that cap. Fix risk overlay and any drawdown breach rule before evaluation.

paper_trade_authorization.authorized_by_user: You may also run paper trades on my account
rules: Use a registered strategy and supported validated execution/accounting code.
Reconcile positions, open orders and buying power before acting; preserve unrelated account activity.
Attribute all paper trades to a strategy and risk tier; keep other tiers in shadow ledgers or isolated paper accounts.
Paper fills alone do not validate an edge; independently account for omitted fees, dividends, borrow and execution effects.

research_policy: One paper or registered hypothesis branch at a time.

Prefer exact/partial native reproduction when inputs exist. If unavailable but methods are sufficient, allow a separately preregistered contemporary mechanism test, explicitly not an original-paper replication.
Native descriptive reproduction, target-market transfer and executable economic validation remain distinct.
Do not retune failed registered tests. Materially different paper-supported branches need a new registration and disclosure of prior outcomes.
Reaudit access-blocked papers against newly verified Alpaca endpoints; distinguish credentials from historical coverage, universe, methods and proprietary inputs.
Maintain a trial ledger and multiplicity control across searched strategies and all three risk tiers; do not cherry-pick the winning tier after outcomes.
Lock model selection/risk scaling on development data, then validate on a registered fresh period; no sealed data release without user instruction.
